items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT STATE / ACTIVE GOAL
- Day 2, 1982.11.24. Two entrants have been processed; no Day 2 citations were visible.
- Third entrant: bald man in red shirt, weight display 74 kg, passport initially on left counter. Last action dragged it from (0.154,0.766) to central desk (0.550,0.750) and completed, but no later screenshot was supplied. First verify that it opened, then inspect nationality, photo/sex/identity data and expiration before deciding. Do not assume its contents.
- Continue admitting valid entrants and denying invalid ones. Regional Map and Booth Info rule-book tabs remain unread.

DAY 2 RULES — OBSERVED
- Foreigners with valid passports may enter; Day 1’s citizens-only restriction no longer applies.
- Rule book Basic Rules: “Entrant must have a passport” and “All documents must be current.”
- Bulletin: deny entrants with inconsistent passport information.
- INSPECT instructions: use red desk button, then highlight two pieces of discrepant information; two conflicting facts enable interrogation. Practical operation remains untested.
- Applicants entering after 6 PM are unpaid.

DAY 2 PROCESSING SO FAR — OBSERVED
1. Woman, 58 kg: REPUBLIA passport, DOB 1959.02.05, F, ISS True Glorian, EXP 1983.04.10. Photo matched and no discrepancy was seen. Visa aligned under APPROVED, stamped, passport returned directly to her; she departed.
2. Shemovsk, Jiahui, 60 kg: ANTEGRIA passport, F, ISS Glorian, EXP 1982.11.16, expired relative to 1982.11.24. Visa aligned under DENIED, stamped, passport returned; entrant departed.
- These are observed decisions, not independent confirmation that they were correct; no citations appeared.

CONTROLS / WORKFLOW — OBSERVED
- Call entrant: loudspeaker (0.305,0.249), displays “NEXT!”; wait for arrival.
- Open passport: drag left counter (~0.154,0.766) to central desk (~0.550,0.750).
- Rule book: simple click on lower-left tab (0.219,0.920) only nudged icon. Drag tab to (~0.520,0.720) to open. Basic Rules tab at (~0.620,0.613). Store by dragging book from (~0.480,0.800) back to (~0.219,0.920).
- From standard central passport position, drag to (~0.662,0.631) for DENIED alignment or (~0.868,0.632) for APPROVED. Verify visually before stamping.
- Successful APPROVED click: (0.854,0.521). Successful DENIED click in the later layout: (0.677,0.445); earlier standard DENIED location was (~0.644,0.519).
- Return documents by dragging from inside the visible passport directly to entrant (~0.145,0.490). Successful origins included (0.720,0.730) and (0.940,0.740). Wait for departure before calling next.
- Right-edge tab (~0.993,0.438) opens/closes storage/stamp panel. Newspaper compartment repeatedly slid out and covered stamps; clicking tab closed it.
- Store bulletin/newspaper by dragging right and using edge tab if needed. Bulletin page turn: folded lower-right (~0.770,0.920).
- Booth shutter: drag lower-left lever handle upward from (~0.037,0.933) to (~0.037,0.881); simple click/wait did not open it.

FAILED STRATEGIES / CAUTIONS
- Dragging the green stamp pulled stored newspaper onto desk, obscuring passport/stamps; stamps are fixed, not draggable.
- Dropping approved passport on left counter only closed it; entrant remained. Direct return to entrant worked.
- Return drag beginning outside visible passport at (0.940,0.760) failed.
- Several actions were rejected for observation_age_limit; this does not establish bad coordinates. Refresh observation before retrying.

DAY 1 / BULLETIN CONTEXT
- Day 1 rule: approve Arstotzkans, deny foreigners. Prasanna Balu approved; Paison Kristopher, Bullock Andrew and Heishamei Ash denied. No citations visible. End summary: CLASS 8, passport icon x5, family all OK.
- Meaning of passport icon x5 remains unresolved.
- All five Day 2 bulletin pages read; page 5 had only “Analysts Upbeat” and “Grestin Checkpoint a Success!”
- Immediate uncertainty is solely the third entrant’s post-drag passport state and details.
